notes.title: Dire Wolf Game Room 1.8.8 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
In addition to a variety of bug fixes and improvements, today’s update to Dire Wolf Game Room brings integration for our newest releases, Ark Nova Digital and Dune: Imperium – Immortality, allowing players to create and join online games straight from the app. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40744859/cf7561e9f88ba3daf68f4ebdbbb43e69c93aa26c.jpg"]


New features:
Ark Nova Digital game creation integration

Dune: Imperium Digital – Immortality game creation integration

Window resizing

Pip that notifies users of new content
Bug fixes:
Addressed several instances of layout issues

Addressed instance of text displaying with surrounding squares

Addressed instance of mislabeled timer options for Munchkin games

Addressed instances of tiny text in companion apps on mobile

As always, if you’re enjoying the Dire Wolf Game Room, please take a moment to leave a review – it’s the best way to help other players discover it! Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Dire Wolf Game Room 1.8.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Today’s patch addresses a number of bug fixes and improvements, and adds game creation functionality for some of our newer digital releases. 

Bug Fixes


 Addressed several instances of games not launching correctly
 Addressed several instances of games not loading with correct options
 Addressed several instances of lobbies not filtering for DLC correctly
 Addressed several instances of lobbies displaying properly
 Resized and repositioned icons across several games
 Addressed text artifact issue appearing on some resolutions
 Corrected instance of visual flicker at 1600x900 resolution
 Corrected horizontal scrollability for News tiles


Game Creation


 Added functionality to launch The Isle of Cats games from Game Room
 Added functionality to launch Ark Nova games from Game Room
 Updated Clank! launcher with Sunken Treasure options.

notes.title: Dire Wolf Game Room Patch Notes 1.8.5
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40744859/d707f1613f26b69b70deaf4e9c55394d5f810865.jpg

We’re adding a bit of magic to the Game Room with this patch! Now, Clank! Legacy Acquisitions Incorporated 2: Darkest Magic has full app support to help you build your campaign, grow your franchise, acquire artifacts, and take on the dragon! Adventure awaits!

Patch Notes

 Experience the Book of Secrets Like Never Before! With the full Book of Secrets available in the app, you can listen to each passage, narrated by a complete voice cast, featuring Jerry and Mike from Penny Arcade! Simply select any passage by number—no spoilers in the menu!—and dive into the story brought to life. A big thanks to our amazing Kickstarter backers for unlocking this! (Just a heads-up: the narration covers the story text, but you’ll still need to follow the game instructions on each passage yourself.)
 Track your Legacy with Mission Reports! The goodies continue with the app’s ability to serve as your Mission Reports document. With this feature, tracking everyone's performance throughout the campaign is easy. You'll enter points as you score them and have the app total it up, identify the winner, and record everything for posterity. Oh yeah, and the Mission Reports screen also links directly to your Prologue and Epilogue passage for each game!
 Keep the Adventure Going! The fun doesn’t end when the campaign does! With the app, you'll have a fully playable, self-customized game of Clank Legacy 2.

notes.title: An Invincible GRM 1.8.4 Update!
notes.notes:
Today’s update brings Invincible: The Hero-Building Game straight into your hands with our new companion app. Learn the ropes in the Tutorial, get some scorekeeping assistance, or try the special Titan episode! And don’t forget, the tabletop game is now available for pre-order.

Patch contents:

Invincible companion app
Bug fixes and optimizations
Upcoming game integration

notes.title: Dire Wolf Game Room Patch Notes 1.8.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40744859/a7bbe772c650d24c40a532e0b80dfbdd8f7f028e.jpg

The latest addition to the Dire Wolf Game Room has gotten sand everywhere!

*Drum roll please* Dune: Imperium is dropping into the Game Room Library, bringing a world of cunning politics, scarce resources, and strategic combat to spice up your game night!

We’ve also addressed a few issues with Root as well as the Clank! Catacombs and Wild Tiled West companion apps. 

Happy playing and may your skills be as sharp as a crysknife! 

Patch details:

 Integration and support for Dune Imperium Digital
 Addressed a Root softlock when using advanced setup
 Bug fixes and improvements for Clank! Catacombs and Wild Tiled West companion apps
